source_side_capability_reconstruction.method: Recover the semantic native margin from fields already emitted before the terminal decision: A base = -base_margin and A donor = donor_reference_margin; P donor source = -base_margin; C base source = base_margin.

diagnosis.failed_condition: The v2 runner required every unused C donor state to prefer its answer. The actuator and C selectivity score use only the C base state; one of sixteen C donor states fails natively under the pre-existing fresh capability authority.
diagnosis.why_unique: The result's emitted margins prove all A base/donor, P donor-source, and C base-source checks pass. The exact-head, fixed-actuator, and coverage predictions also pass. The authority records all 16 C bases and 15 of 16 C donors as correct.
diagnosis.instrument_effect: The extra C-donor condition makes the registered v2 terminal invalid, but it does not contaminate any emitted A, P, or C intervention score because that donor state is never an actuator source or a C score endpoint.

interpretation: A direction-only prototype gets every intervention sign right and is highly selective, but retains only about 22% of the target-guided v10 recovery and misses the frozen 0.50 A and P bars. Carrier amplitude is input-dependent; two direction scalars are insufficient.
next_action: Test a preregistered input-dependent scalar predictor from the base has-versus-had native margin, fitted only on lexical rows and frozen on fresh A/P/C rows.
